mapper.select: SELECT meal_id as id, user_id AS userId, meal_name AS mealName, meal_time AS mealTime, description, image_url AS imageUrl, calories, protein, carbs, fat, meal_date AS mealDate FROM meals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND meal_date = #{date}

SELECT meal_id as id, user_id AS userId, meal_name AS mealName, meal_time AS mealTime, description, image_url AS imageUrl, calories, protein, carbs, fat, meal_date AS mealDate FROM meals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND meal_date BETWEEN #{monday} AND #{sunday} ORDER BY meal_date
